intent.proves: Translations of products, field labels and list options: label-translations satisfies the selected profile assertion.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.reason: Needs authenticated full-payload and scope parity measurement; descriptor existence alone is insufficient.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomProductCategoryFieldTranslation t WHERE t.FieldTranslationLanguageId <> N'{lang}' AND t.FieldTranslationFieldCategoryId <> N'reference_category' AND ISNULL(t.FieldTranslationFieldLabel, N'') <> N'' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductLanguageId = t.FieldTranslationLanguageId)
